vachanas.kannada:
ಹುಂಜ ಸೋತಡೆ ಹಿಡಿವೆ.
ವ್ರತ ಹೋದವರ ನೋಡೆನು,
ಚಂದ್ರಚೂಡೇಶ್ವರಲಿಂಗವೆ.
vachanas.transliteration:
hun̄ja sōtaḍe hiḍive.
vrata hōdavara nōḍenu,
candracūḍēśvaraliṅgave.
vachanas.translation:
If the rooster loses the fight, it is seized.
I will not even look upon those who have abandoned their sacred vow.
O Candracūḍēśvaraliṅga.
